nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a finite-dimensional real normed space. If $K \subseteq E$ is compact, then the convex hull of $K$ is compact.
nodes.title: Convex hull of a compact set is compact

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$, and let $h : E^* \to \mathbb{R}$ be convex. For all $x, v \in E^*$, the function $s \mapsto h(x + s v)$ is convex on $\mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Restriction of a convex function to a line

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a finite-dimensional real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$, let $K \subseteq E$ be a nonempty compact set with support function $h_K$, and write $h_K'(\ell; v)$ for the directional derivative of $h_K$ at $\ell$ in direction $v$. Then the Gateaux points of $h_K$, that is, the functionals $\ell \in E^*$ with $h_K'(\ell; v) + h_K'(\ell; -v) \le 0$ for every $v \in E^*$, form a dense subset of $E^*$.
nodes.title: Mazur's theorem for support functions

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$, let $h : E^* \to \mathbb{R}$ be convex, and write $h'(x; v)$ for the directional derivative of $h$ at $x$ in direction $v$. For all $x, v \in E^*$, $h'(x; v) + h'(x; -v) \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Opposite directional derivatives have nonnegative sum

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$, let $K \subseteq E$ be a nonempty compact set with support function $h_K$, and write $h_K'(x; w)$ for the directional derivative of $h_K$ at $x$ in direction $w$. For every $x \in E^*$, the map $w \mapsto h_K'(x; w)$ is continuous on $E^*$.
nodes.title: Continuity of the directional derivative of a support function in the direction

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$, let $h : E^* \to \mathbb{R}$ be convex, and write $h'(x; v)$ for the directional derivative of $h$ at $x$ in direction $v$. For all $x, v, w \in E^*$, $h'(x; v + w) \le h'(x; v) + h'(x; w)$.
nodes.title: Subadditivity of the directional derivative

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$, let $K \subseteq E$ be a nonempty compact set with support function $h_K$, and write $h_K'(x; v)$ for the directional derivative of $h_K$ at $x$ in direction $v$. For every $v \in E^*$ and every real $c$, the set of $x \in E^*$ with $h_K'(x; v) + h_K'(x; -v) < c$ is open.
nodes.title: Strict sublevel sets of the symmetrized directional derivative are open

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$, let $K \subseteq E$ be a nonempty compact set with support function $h_K$, and write $h_K'(x; w)$ for the directional derivative of $h_K$ at $x$ in direction $w$. If $C$ is a real number with $h_K(\ell_1) - h_K(\ell_2) \le C \|\ell_1 - \ell_2\|$ for all $\ell_1, \ell_2 \in E^*$, then $h_K'(x; w) \le C \|w\|$ for all $x, w \in E^*$.
nodes.title: Lipschitz bound on directional derivatives of a support function

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$ and let $h : E^* \to \mathbb{R}$ be any function. For every $x \in E^*$, the directional derivative of $h$ at $x$ in direction $0$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Directional derivative in direction zero

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space with continuous dual $E^*$. For $h : E^* \to \mathbb{R}$ and $x, v \in E^*$, the directional derivative of $h$ at $x$ in direction $v$ is the infimum of the difference quotients, $h'(x; v) = \inf_{t > 0} \frac{h(x + t v) - h(x)}{t}$, which is taken to be $0$ when these quotients are not bounded below.
nodes.title: Directional derivative

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space, $E^*$ its continuous dual, and $h : E^* \to \mathbb{R}$ a convex function. For all $x, v \in E^*$, the set of difference quotients $\{(h(x + t v) - h(x))/t : t > 0\}$ is bounded below.
nodes.title: Difference quotients of a convex function are bounded below

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space and $E^*$ its continuous dual. For $h : E^* \to \mathbb{R}$ and $x, v \in E^*$, the difference quotients of $h$ at $x$ in direction $v$ form the set $\{(h(x + t v) - h(x))/t : t > 0\}$.
nodes.title: Difference quotients

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space, $E^*$ its continuous dual, and $h : E^* \to \mathbb{R}$. For $x, v \in E^*$ let $h'(x; v)$ be the infimum of the difference quotients $(h(x + t v) - h(x))/t$ over $t > 0$, taken to be $0$ when they are unbounded below. A point $x \in E^*$ is a Gateaux point of $h$ when $h'(x; v) + h'(x; -v) \le 0$ for every $v \in E^*$.
nodes.title: Gateaux points

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty compact subset of a real normed space $E$, and let $h_K(l) = \sup_{y \in K} l(y)$ be its support function on the continuous dual $E^*$. If $l \in E^*$ is a Gateaux point of $h_K$ and $z_1, z_2 \in K$ satisfy $l(z_1) = h_K(l)$ and $l(z_2) = h_K(l)$, then $z_1 = z_2$.
nodes.title: Maximizers at a Gateaux point of the support function are unique

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty compact subset of a real normed space $E$, let $h_K(l) = \sup_{y \in K} l(y)$ be its support function on the continuous dual $E^*$, and write $h_K'(u; v)$ for the directional derivative of $h_K$ at $u$ in direction $v$. If $u \in E^*$ and $z \in K$ satisfy $u(z) = h_K(u)$, then $v(z) \le h_K'(u; v)$ for every $v \in E^*$.
nodes.title: A maximizer bounds the directional derivative of the support function from below

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a finite-dimensional real normed space and let $A \subseteq E$ be a compact convex set. Then every extreme point of $A$ lies in the closure of the set of exposed points of $A$.
nodes.title: Straszewicz's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty compact subset of a real normed space $E$, and let $h_K(l) = \sup_{x \in K} l(x)$ be its support function on the continuous dual $E^*$. For every $l \in E^*$ there is $x \in K$ with $l(x) = h_K(l)$.
nodes.title: The support function of a compact set is attained

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty compact subset of a real normed space $E$. Its support function $h_K(l) = \sup_{x \in K} l(x)$ is continuous on the continuous dual $E^*$ with the operator norm.
nodes.title: The support function of a compact set is continuous

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty compact subset of a real normed space $E$. Its support function $h_K(l) = \sup_{x \in K} l(x)$ is a convex function on the whole continuous dual $E^*$.
nodes.title: The support function of a compact set is convex

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty compact subset of a real normed space $E$, and let $h_K(l) = \sup_{x \in K} l(x)$ be its support function on the continuous dual $E^*$. There is a constant $C \ge 0$ such that $h_K(l_1) - h_K(l_2) \le C \|l_1 - l_2\|$ for all $l_1, l_2 \in E^*$, where $\|\cdot\|$ is the operator norm.
nodes.title: The support function of a compact set is Lipschitz

nodes.summary: For a set $K$ in a real normed space $E$, the support function of $K$ sends a continuous linear functional $\ell$ on $E$ to the supremum $\sup_{x \in K} \ell(x)$ of the values of $\ell$ on $K$.
nodes.title: Support function

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nonempty compact set in a real normed space $E$, let $\ell$ be a continuous linear functional on $E$, and let $h_K$ be the support function of $K$. If $z \in K$ satisfies $\ell(z) = h_K(\ell)$ and every $y \in K$ with $\ell(y) = h_K(\ell)$ equals $z$, then $z$ is an exposed point of $K$.
nodes.title: A unique maximizer of a linear functional is an exposed point

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
